title: Example 2: image processing request over CBOR

source.note: composed from a verbatim example: as for Example 1, the message is printed as Python pseudo-code. The payload `b'\xff\xd8\xff\xe0...'` is composed as the four bytes it shows, ff d8 ff e0 (a JPEG SOI/APP0 header). The CBOR is produced by conformance/tools/cbor_encode.py from the same JSON description.

notes: §7.1 puts binary content in a CBOR byte string, so no base64 is involved on this wire; canonical_json spells the same bytes as padded base64, which is what §7.2's text fallback would have carried.
